_story: Conflict simulation (infeasible): mandatory pharmacy (3 kW) + normal grocery_fridge (3 kW) = 6 kW > 5 kW capacity. The grocery_fridge has been dark for max_consecutive_dark=2 consecutive outage hours, so Rule 6 forces it on in the 3rd outage hour, but Rule 3 (capacity) forbids it. The solver must report infeasibility with both rules and shops named.
